card.name: Start of a drug name after 'the'
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug name that is split into several parts, usually right after a word like 'the', 'between', 'receiving' or 'Take'. Examples are laz(ertinib), tram(adol), zale(plon) and pom(alidomide).

modes.label: Drug name start
modes.description: The opening piece of a drug name, right after a determiner or verb in label text.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: A part of a non-drug word such as incubators or a surname, also split into pieces.

card.plain: It fires at the first chunk of a drug name that the model has to read in pieces, such as lazertinib or tramadol.
